slides.say: In a Server Components app, everything is server rendered by default. Use client marks what runs on the client.
Put use client at the very top of the file, above any imports. Then this component can use state.

slides.text: The module AND everything it imports become client code.
slides.say: It marks the module and all its transitive dependencies as client code. It creates a boundary in the module dependency tree.

slides.text: Single or double quotes, not backticks. No effect if imported from client code already.
slides.say: Write it with single or double quotes, not backticks. When imported from another client module, the directive has no extra effect.
